hook: I robbed the same jacket twice. Jason nearly got us locked inside with it.
script: I robbed the same jacket twice. Jason nearly got us locked inside with it. Our diamonds were stitched into its lining. He had sent it for cleaning without checking. Through the shutter, I saw it traveling toward the overnight delivery chute. Then any van could have it. Jason reached for the emergency stop. A sign warned that button sealed every exit until reset. Then I noticed the inspection pedal beneath the rail. Its arrow pointed backward: inspect both sides. He squeezed under the half-closed shutter and held the pedal. The conveyor reversed. Our jacket came toward me. I caught its sleeve, stripped the hanger out, and pulled Jason free before the shutter closed. Outside, I cut the seam. Diamonds spilled into his palm. Next time, I told him, try doing the laundry yourself.
